module: K-d tree for 2D boxes (xmin, ymin, xmax, ymax), hence 4 dimensions, allowing quick retrieval of all the elements whose box intersects a query area. Typically used for road segments, zones or obstacles. Flow: new -> preLoad (for each element) -> build -> query / queryNotNested. Queries are Lua iterators usable in a for loop.
usage:
local kdTreeB2d = require('kdtreebox2d')
local kdT = kdTreeB2d.new(itemCount) -- itemCount optional (preallocation)
for _, it in ipairs(items) do kdT:preLoad(it.id, it.xmin, it.ymin, it.xmax, it.ymax) end
kdT:build()
for id in kdT:queryNotNested(xmin, ymin, xmax, ymax) do ... end   -- non-nested queries
for id1 in kdT:query(xmin, ymin, xmax, ymax) do                    -- nested queries (creates garbage)
  for id2 in kdT:query(...) do ... end
end
notes: Elements are stored flat in self.items in groups of 5 values (xmin, ymin, xmax, ymax, id). Before build(), self.itemCount counts values (x5); after build() it is divided by 5 and becomes the number of elements.
The iterators return the id of each element whose box intersects the query box (inclusive). The query bounds are clamped to ±1.7e308 to accept infinities.

queryNotNested reuses the tree's internal state: another query cannot be nested (neither queryNotNested nor query on the same tree during iteration with queryNotNested). query allocates a new state per call and supports nesting.
build() must be called only once after all the preLoad calls (it modifies itemCount). Calling query before build() fails (tree == nil).
clear() does nothing as long as the tree has not been built (self.tree == nil). After clear the object can be reused (preLoad then build).

new.desc: Creates an empty 2D box k-d tree.

itemCount.desc: expected number of elements, to preallocate (optional)

kdTree.desc: Object returned by new(). Fields: tree, items, itemCount, nonLeafLimIdx and internal query states.

id.desc: element id returned by the queries

build.desc: Builds the tree from the loaded elements (recursive median selection alternating the 4 axes).

_build.desc: Internal: recursive construction of a node; returns the bounding box of the subtree.

query.desc: Iterator (to use in for) over the ids of the elements intersecting the given box; supports nested queries.

queryNotNested.desc: Like query but without allocation (reuses the tree's state): do not nest.

clear.desc: Empties an existing tree to reuse it (useful for frequently updated trees). No effect before build.

export.desc: Returns a table {tree, nonLeafLimIdx, items, itemCount} (references, no copy) to serialize or reuse it.

import.desc: Replaces the content with data produced by export().

analytics.desc: Prints (print) tree statistics: depth, number of nodes, leaves, elements.
